title: Prospective Event-Targeted TT Causal Replay, Full-Key/Ply Semantic Intervention Addressing, Minimal Root-Move Sufficient Event Sets, Principal-Variation Counterfactual Reconstruction, Chess-Concept Grounding & Verified Natural-Language Explanation Synthesis

objective.primary: localize P31 semantic-class root-move dependencies to addressable individual TT-use events or event interactions
objective.necessity: find intervention-address sets whose removal changes the frozen root move and certify inclusion-minimality by replay
objective.sufficiency: starting from a prospectively defined addressable family-null frontier, find retained event sets sufficient to restore the native root move and certify inclusion-minimality by replay
objective.explanation: compile PV-contrast and mechanically verified chess-concept facts only after event-level certificates are sealed

support.primary_cases: all 17 P31 single-family root dependencies plus the one pure MOVE_ORDER+EVAL interaction-only case
support.secondary_interaction_replication: the non-pure MOVE_ORDER+EVAL interaction on stockfish_19/b27b... is retained as a diagnostic replication but does not inflate the primary case count

intervention_address.occurrence_semantics: baseline_signature_occurrence is the 1-based count among events with identical preceding address fields in the native BASE catalogue
intervention_address.targeted_replay: a target fires only when the same structural signature reaches the frozen occurrence count; requested-but-unreached targets are recorded, never silently remapped
intervention_address.measurement_only: all P32 interventions activate only when TT search sequence == 5

frontier_localization.procedure: for each P31 root-dependent family case, block every family event whose ply is at or below the frontier; select the smallest prospectively ordered frontier that changes the root move away from BASE
frontier_localization.authorization: minimal event-set claims are authorized only inside a frontier that demonstrably changes root bestmove
frontier_localization.unresolved: if ply<=8 never changes root bestmove, classify DEEPER_OR_NONADDRESSABLE and do not fabricate event-level localization

removal_set.name: difference-making removal set
removal_set.predicate: blocking exactly the addressed set changes bestmove away from BASE
removal_set.search: deterministic ddmin-style partition search over the frozen frontier catalogue
removal_set.certificate: every retained event is leave-one-out necessary for the found set; otherwise MINIMALITY_HOLD
removal_set.claim: inclusion-minimal under frozen address/replay semantics, not globally minimum cardinality

retaining_set.name: sufficient retaining set
retaining_set.predicate: with all other frontier-family events blocked, permitting exactly the addressed set restores BASE bestmove
retaining_set.search: deterministic subset minimization followed by leave-one-out verification
retaining_set.certificate: every retained event is necessary within the sufficient set; otherwise SUFFICIENCY_MINIMALITY_HOLD
retaining_set.claim: inclusion-minimal sufficient set relative to the frozen frontier-null intervention, not universal sufficient causation

minimality.nonmonotonicity: search responses need not be monotone in event sets; any budget exhaustion or failed final verification is a HOLD, not an inferred minimal cause

pv_counterfactual.first_divergence: first legal PV ply where UCI moves differ; unequal termination is represented explicitly
pv_counterfactual.legality_gate: every parsed PV prefix used for concept claims must replay legally from the frozen FEN

chess_concept_grounding.representation: deterministic python-chess feature extraction from frozen root FEN and certified PV prefixes
allowed_atomic_claims: passed-pawn status for a moved pawn
prohibited_unverified_claims: why the engine wanted a move
chess_concept_grounding.rule: higher-level motif language requires a separate mechanical predicate; otherwise explanations remain atomic and contrastive

explanation_verification.architecture: certificate -> explanation AST -> deterministic renderer -> independent verifier
explanation_verification.verifier: every rendered factual clause must map to a certificate/grounding field; unsupported clauses fail the workflow
explanation_verification.natural_language: generated only from verified AST; no free-form post-hoc rationale is authoritative

geiger_2025.note: No DOI is listed by JMLR; Drive copy already present.

halpern_pearl_2005.use: actual causality and minimal causal structure

beckers_2021.use: causal sufficiency and NESS-style necessary-element-of-sufficient-set framing

parfenova_2026.use: chess-specific warning that fluent explanations need not reflect decisions

claim_ceiling: Event causation is relative to the frozen single-thread 1 MiB warmed-TT search procedure and exact address-trigger semantics.
An addressed event may be unreachable after an earlier intervention; reachability is part of the counterfactual result and targets are never remapped.
Inclusion-minimal is not minimum-cardinality and is never upgraded to a unique cause claim.
A sufficient retaining set is sufficient only relative to the frozen frontier-null intervention and support world.
Fixed-node-budget path divergence remains part of the intervention semantics.
Chess-concept statements are mechanically grounded properties of legal moves/PV prefixes, not claims about strategic intent.
No prevalence or cross-position generalization beyond the selected P31 root-dependent cases is authorized.
